text: We stumbled in this delicious restaurant by chance tonight.  They hit it out of the park! Nate was a great server and very accommodating to our table. I had a hot and sour soup and a rice bowl with ahi tuna.  It was excellent! Highly recommended!

We visited Applebee's in Pennsville NJ and were really disappointed again.   The meat was hot, the fries were cold, the red wine was cold instead of a room temp.  The grilled vegetables were warm but not cleaned properly, the peppers still had the seeds.  We asked for extra napkins because one of us had ribs but no napkins ever came.   So, I went to their website to give a review and that didn't work either.   

The question is...where do you eat in Pennsville????   Better yet, next time we'll eat in Delaware before our meeting in NJ.

I would give 0 stars if I could. Aside from shoving their radical political beliefs down your throat. The food tasted sour. I spent 3 days throwing up from food poisoning. Don't go here ! Do yourself a favor

2 pieces of tendon from 2 different bowls but both had hairs. And the ones on the right look embedded inside the tendon... I guess whoever prepares the tendon needs to be more careful

Also the spring rolls were extremely overpriced
As you can see from the photos, foods are served with large amount. They are also very tasty and the service was good.

The food is good,  the portions are pretty large. Watch your step when here though - you'd think you were drunk walking on the tilted floors. The walk to the bathroom should be lined with hazard cones. It's cool that the building has such history, but it honestly is hard to navigate. 
So watch your step and be ready to feel like you're gonna pop when you leave.

Excellent food! Seriously gourmet food that is top shelf goodness. The grilled chicken and broccoli is my recommendation! Nice atmosphere and good service. The chief is the star of the show at this location.

3.5 stars rounding down. 

Ordered the tofu vermicelli, mushrooms dumplings, pickled veggies and Thai milk tea. 

The best by far were the dumplings. They were light and had strong flavor. The rest was so so good but average good. 

The pickled veggies are veggies dipped in a vinegar sauce. Not worth the side in my opinion.

Really glad this place is nearby and happy with the price point. The customer service is on point and their menu selection is pretty great.
If you say you are open to 6pm, honor those hours. I placed an order for delivery at 5:15 and your staff left without my pizza being delivered.

I loved everything that I tried here. Super good food and service too. I got the chili which was a little heavy and the mushroom fake meat but still pretty good. The vegan chicken nuggets are delicious.
The food and service is great. Our server, Kayla, was attentive and had a great attitude.

This is my favorite place to get sushi in Santa Barbara! And yes I have been to both Arigato and Sakana. I highly recommend getting the nigiri there. They serve fresh fish and ingredients so they do run out a lot but restock for the weekends. The owner is also super friendly.
James our handsome server was so sweet and awesome! He was so funny and a delight. Our food was great and the blackberry mimosas were the bomb per his recommendation. We def will be back!

Really nice ramen spot! Came for lunch with my boyfriend on a weekday and it was decently full but we were still able to be seated right away. We split edamame, I got the green curry ramen with pork, and my boyfriend got the nom nom ramen with pork. I wish I had been hungrier as I would have loved to try the pork buns (sensing a pork theme).

Edamame was standard and came out quickly, followed shortly by the ramen. Wowza it was good! Absolutely delicious broth, great noodles, very tender pork (though I wish there had been more of it!). The green curry had a great umami flavor and the nom nom ramen had very perfect spice - awesome flavor without burning your face off. 

I polished off the whole bowl and said "I can't believe I ate all that." Usually I can't finish full ramen portions, so that says something about how good it was. I think it was slightly smaller than other ramen bowls I've had, but it was still a solid accomplishment, I think. One thing to be aware of is that they're cash only, which is always frustrating as someone who never carries cash. 

Service was quick which was good because we only had about 45 mins for lunch. Accepting cards and a little bit more pork in the ramen and this would be a full 5 stars! I wish I could give 4.5 :)

This place has really really great service. Lilly comes around and asks people how they're doing and their food comes out quickly. I had the spring rolls, pho tai and a chrysanthemum tea. All good! The chrysanthemum tea is a little bit sweetened and very refreshing. I liked the spring rolls that they had avocado and strawberry. The strawberry keeps it light  and tart, and you can't go wrong with avocado so. It was great. 

The pho tai was pretty good as well. I think the soup broth didn't have as much depth of flavor as I have had in the past. But I am also spoiled with a friend that makes super great home made pho. Can't beat that! But the beef was good, although a bit thin and in small strips (I prefer when it's whole pieces). 

They seem to have a lot of regulars and overall I had a very pleasant experience and was a great comfort for my cold I had that day!

This place is brew-tiful! The ambience is super cute - somehow both very open and cozy! The low buzz of music and people make this a great place to hang with friends or to chill and work! I've been here a few times and have never been disappointed. I usually get the miel latte (soooo good) but this time I got a Vietnamese iced coffee (also delicious)! I've also had their quiche which had wonderfully flaky pastry and a creamy and flavorful filling.

In COVID times I think this is a top option for coffee shops. They have a small patio in the front for outdoor seating. As I mentioned earlier the inside is very spacious and the available tables are nicely spaced out so they are definitely practicing good public health and you can tell they care about the safety of their employees and patrons. 10/10 would recommend!
Best Indian food in town! I order from here at least once a week. They are always quick and have my order ready. Great friendly service

Have tried to place an order to be pick be picked up for the next day, the person on the counter could not even understand english and should be a easy transaction, place my order and pay for an order to be picked up the next day, that was too much for the person to understand and still order was not placed and paid for it and she could not get it right, my nephew went to pick it up and not paid for, please hire people who know how to place a order to be picked up the next day, easy, charge and let the cooks know, called several times to talk to owner, if the person taking the call could understand english and take my number, could be resolved, owner never calls

This is my favorite pizza place in Philadelphia!!  We had the smoky mozzarella sticks as an appetizer. They were amazing!!  The pizza is always delicious. I love the thicker crust. If you haven't been there yet, you gotta try it.

I've rated this place a 1 star due to their horrible sides it's 2020 you should always be implementing in flavor and well cooked food . Their baked MAC was served to me OVERCOOKED it was disgusting!!!! Their Yams DIsgusting!!! I'm here writing this to save y'all money !! They need to work on their recipes!!!!!

This place is a must try! The food here is so tasty and delectable. This is definitely our favorite Chinese restaurant! There are so many delicious vegan options and non-vegan options.  We tried their Singapore noodles, house fried rice with veggie beef, Chinese organic eggplant with white rice and Mongolian veggie beef. Everything was absolutely amazing! The owner Ming is so sweet, friendly, and very helpful in suggesting great options. I wish they had a location in San Diego, but my family and I will be looking forward to our next visit to Tucson to come back here. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for the BEST Chinese dining experience.

This is my favorite place in all of st pete! I travel
For work from LA and come to st pete every month and this place is always my first stop! Great vibes, energy, management and best customer service. The poke and sauces are so fresh and delicious this is my favorite poke place!  this is a must go if you're in st pete!

Food service excellent. Being able to eat on Bourbon Street a plus. I was impressed by the quality of the dinners we had. I had planned to go to one of NOLA old legendary restaurants for dinner that evening. They had a host on the street who was telling us about Mambos and he convinced us to try the food. We were. To disappointed. They serve all 3 meal periods but we were very pleased and will return on our upcoming visit.
I had the Burrata salad and added grilled chicken.  Literally one of the best salads I have had- EVER.  I will definitely be back!

Since I first came to Fiesta Chicken soon after they opened, I've been here two more times. They have solved the problems I identified on that initial visit.

They hired more people,  so the ordering process is much easier. They're still busy at lunchtime, but the crazy long lines have mellowed out.

I like their tacos, but just like my experience at their Ustick shop, I tend to order the chicken because it's so good.

Service ais friendly and the food is served in a reasonable time.

Dining the way it's supposed to be done.

We walked in and were had the choice of several different menu types and seating areas. We chose to sit in the basement because we could still hear the live band on the first floor but it was calm enough to enjoy our meal and hear each other speak. 

We were promptly seated upon arrival by the hostess and our waiter was quick to take a drink order and explain the menu.

We ordered an appetizer (kettle chips) to split, and my wife decided to get the Nashville Hot bites as a meal. Me on the other hand, I got the Nashville burger. Our waiter asked us how hungry we were, implying that we were getting a lot of food (trying to warn us). We were starving- it had been a long day and we hadn't eaten in 10 hours. We normally don't have a problem eating an appetizer and most of our meal... we did this time! Portions were huge!

The kettle chips were fantastic! Definitely enough for a few people to share as an appetizer or for one person to eat as their meal. The Nashville bites had great flavor and were just the right amount of heat. The burger was delicious, but could not be cooked to order. 

After dinner, we wandered up to the rooftop where a great acoustic band was playing. It was much more "chill" than Jason Aldeen's rooftop bar that is right next to it. It was nice having the option to walk back and forth to listen to either band.

Walked in during happy hour. Was busy both at the bar the seating areas.  People were standing waiting for tables.  No one greeted us or acknowledged our presence, while we were standing there for a few minutes.  Not sure if it's a seat yourself place or if someone seats you, so we just walked out.

I just recently discovered breakfast here, and I am so glad that I did!  I had driven past this place many, many times and didn't realize they served breakfast.  A few weeks ago I noticed a breakfast bowl advertised on their sign so I decided to stop by and give it a try.

Breakfast here has to be one of Indy's best kept secrets.  The food is made fresh and tastes homemade.  Servings are huge and prices are very reasonable.  The employees are friendly and the drive-thru line moves really fast.

The breakfast menu is pretty extensive and everything I have tried is wonderful.  I recommend the breakfast burrito and potatoes, but you can't go wrong with anything on the menu.

This is a local Boise habit for residents who like consistently good all around non-fast food style Mexican food.  It's located in a small strip mall on Parkcenter with easy parking.  We are regular eaters of Mexican food, and while we may not be eating overly hot & spicy food with chiles and cilantro, I will say that have recently eaten at some inviting places downtown with great decor, but the food is pricey and nothing speak of. So we happily end up at back La Tapitia for good food for a good price.

The menu is typical, with a few twists, and also includes some seafood dishes that they are known for, and there is a special every night. The food was hot and good, in large portions, and the rice was moist not dried out as often is the case elsewhere. The refried beans are so so flavorful, that they even serve them with their warm chips as a dip along with their salsa and guac.  You can't go wrong with this place and its convenient location east of downtown.
The place has a Great style to showcase the old to new Aland the taste are phenomenal . The drinks are inspirational and a must go to if you are in Nashville.

I've been coming to Kristina's for about 5 years. No frills, but affordable and decent food. Service is usually good, but occasionally it can be a little off. But still, no complaints from me overall.

We were driving through Reno craving a burger and found Beefy's. When we pulled up I thought maybe we had the wrong place! Turns out, this is the BEST BURGER IVE EVER HAD. I had the Nevadan (cheeseburger) and my boyfriend had the one w/ bacon and blue cheese. The soft bun, crunchy onion and pickle, and perfectly cooked patty (super juicy inside and crispy on the outside) were amazing.

We recently moved to Plant City, and we wanted to try a pizza place with delivery that wasn't a chain restaurant, so we picked Nick's. Ordering was a breeze, and delivery was alright... The driver had a hard time finding our house in the dark which is understandable. Our food, wasn't the greatest we've ever had... I ordered the white pizza, which was kind of bland. I also ordered a hoagie to try, and did not like that it was grilled. It was a little bit too salty to my taste. The portion sizes were pretty good though. My friend got a meatball sub, and said it was really good. We also got zeppolis for dessert which (in my opinion tasted good) but seemed a little cold or even stale maybe. I still enjoyed those the most. I was surprised that they didn't come with a chocolate or raspberry dipping sauce. I will try this place again, but I will order a regular pizza next time and the zeppolis again, because maybe it was just the day, and I would love to find a really good local New York style pizza. So I'm willing to give it a second shot, and if I do, I'll come back to update my review!

Could not have been more crowded today (World Cup finals - literally standing packed in) and the STAFF was absolutely INCREDIBLE. Only had beer so can't comment on the food but the beer was great and the service was even better. Thanks for a great experience!

Friends invited us to hear sax music early in the day at this newly renamed and remodeled establishment in a tiny strip mall in Largo. The happy hour is 4-7 and reasonably priced. The house was rocking with an older crowd dancing and enjoying the music and stepping up for open-mic fun.

 With all of the new TVs we are looking forward to enjoying it as the sports bar venue too. The bar is u-shaped with ample comfortable barstools and with all of the tables, everyone had a seat. 

We went two Mondays in a row and Sheila, bartender, ensured we had fun and no one had to wait long for a re-fill. The other bartenders are also very friendly and accommodating. We ordered wings both times and they were delicious. We ordered french fries smothered in cheese the first time there and they were delicious. The second visit we ordered fries with a side of cheese sauce and a side of gravy. The cheese sauce this time was gooey and unappealing; the gravy seemed to be made from a packet and tasted like a dirty grill (meh). We should have just passed on the sauces.  The fries, however, were crispy, hot and tasty. The wings were perfect-o. 

Although it probably won't be a Monday again, we plan to go again soon.
Excellent Chicken Fried Steak entree!  We used Yelp reservations and got right in without wait.  Very limited children's menu.  Waitstaff was great!

Order anything and it is wonderful.  We love their vegetarian fried rice, spicy noodles, and  Bangkok eggplant.  We used to love the moon dumplings but for some reason they took it off the menu='(  But all their food is soo good we will get over it!

I am thrilled with the customer service I have received from the resort. Regina, a manager there, helped me cancel my non-refundable reservation during this pandemic. She was helpful, knowledgeable, and friendly. The resort didn't have to take care of me, but they did. I truly appreciate this and feel it shows an integrity we need right now. It is really hard for everyone right now, and Safety Harbor helped me during this trying time. It means a lot.
This place is awesome! They have Taylor Ham which usually you can only find in NY or NJ. The Taylor ham egg and cheese sandwich in a bagel tasted like I was back home in NY.

I would have taken a picture of our food if we didn't devour it so quickly. My husband and I love Thai food. We moved to Philadelphia four months ago and have tried many Thai restaurants so far but none were as good as Erawan. Everything was fresh and flavorful. Delicious! We will definitely be back.

The new Siam square is terrible. The idea that you have to order your food at the counter then they bring it to your table. I asked why they changed. They replied for faster food service. It actually took longer to receive my food. 
You also have to get your own drinks as well. Why are we even tipping? 
There was one small space heater in the back of the restaurant which is not sufficient. 
I will not be returning. 
I discovered a different Thai restaurant that I like better now.

We've been going there for years. And we go often. Never had a bad meal never had bad service never had a bad drink. Based on quality and consistency, It's not a ridiculous thing to say that this is one of the best restaurants in the state. Favorite Sushi is Godzilla Roll. Fave dish is hibachi combo shrimp and steak but in the sit-down restaurant to the right. The chop chop hibachi grills are to the left.  Favorite drink is the Jade Pear which is made with pear flavored vodka.

This place did not disappoint! 
The food was fresh and amazing ! The street tacos are small but that's expected hence the name ! Order more ! I know it sounds outrageous but 4/5 will fill you up ! Do not short hand yourself . The sides are all great , skip the guacamole and chips and save room for more street tacos !

Next stop is Neyows Cafe! This is as authentic as a creole cafe can get. I got the Grilled Fish and Stuffed Crab with Carrot Soufflé and Sautéed Potatoes as my sides. This place is a very popular black owned spot conveniently located in Mid City. I definitely recommend checking it out.
Great food and nice servers. I would do it again and order the fish tacos. I would experience eating outside. Great weather.

Best little hidden cafe. Gotta stop here. The food is fantastic and the cook is entertaining. There are old people, young people and everyone in between. The cooks music is loud and uplifting and he's sings to the top of his lungs to every song and so does everyone in the whole restaurant. There's only about 10 tables and a counter but it was definitely worth the stop. So entertaining and delicious.
Very good for date night! The waiter was very knowledgeable and explained everything in detail. Great ambiance. Would definitely return.

Just went to Goldberg's Deli on Roosevelt Way In the CBD in New Orleans to buy their excellent bagels and grab brunch. Met a worker outside their locked doors. They closed, effective today, May 5. No advance word. No severance. All employees now out of a job.  Terrible practice by an employer today off its employees like this with no advance notice.
Pretty average Chinese food. Not in my top 5 favorites in town but I wouldn't discourage anyone from going.

Update: We decided to place an order online for delivery a few hours beforehand so it would come on time. All things considered, we were satisfied with the food (as per usual), but it was kind of an unfortunate experience with the delivery system. Having placed an order over three hours in advanced, it would have been nice if it arrived on the scheduled time. I understand and appreciate their effort though considering everything going on. I also know that the times are relative and estimates as events are unpredictable. With this in mind, they have a great system in place. I will just have to set the time a little sooner next time to be safe. 

Old Review: Quick and easy delivery and service. We ordered online for dinner, and the food came fresh and hot. The food itself was delicious as usual and really good pot. I really commend all of Outback's efforts during covid to keep both their staff and guests safe.

I have not had the opportunity to actually eat here yet although I will in the near future however this place really stepped up at the start of the pandemic. They opened up a little market if you will, selling essentials such as toilet paper, paper towels and various other items. The manager did a great job helping out the community!
We had lunch today a Mexicali Grill. Great fish tacos and seafood chimichanga.  Delicious.

huge shoutout to TRAVIS! his service was memorable and a highlight of our trip down to bourbon st. i came here on a saturday night with my family, we all reconnected in NOLA so it was a great time with good eats. this place is in between all the chaos on the bourbon strip & surrounded by other restaurants with bright neon lights. we started with the alligator appetizer & this came with comeback sauce (5/5) alligator was fresh & breaded perfectly to my liking, wasn't too crunchy or crispy or way too soft. i also ordered the seafood pasta which was disappointing to say the least. the noodles were really over cooked and the sauce was not flavorful at all. on the upside of this, i got a free glass of wine because i checked in on YELP which was a perk! :) come here for drunk eats like we did! probably best to stay away from the pastas.

Oh my God, Angelo's Pizzeria was really incredible. A very unique environment. The staff told us that we really should try their Drunk Cutlet Sandwich, and they were right, it was truly amazing. The crew was extremely courteous and service is perfect. I cannot wait to return!

First time in Tampa and was looking for a quick bite to get the day started. Capital tacos hit the spot and much more. Starting with queso was the right decision. Perfect blend of soft and spice. We had the Hen House, Caballero, Austinite and Mean Verde. All delicious but the Austinite was first among equals. My friend was vegetarian so Kris helped us out by swappingo the meat with peppers and onions, no problem. It looks like they have a great local beer selection but it being 11am we did not take advantage. Can't wait to try their other locations.

One of the few places my mom loves for Chinese food. Every time she comes to visit we go here. The food isn't too salty, they always give you a lot, and the staff is very nice. I would say the only downsides are the service can sometimes be slow, and it is a bit expensive if you are looking for cheaper Chinese food. Sometimes the quality of the food is also not the same, but for the most part everything has been really good.
New COVID online seating is uncomfortable. Loss of social interaction is foreign and unsettling. Beware of a FAR different setting contrary to stale or outdated online publications.

Ordered delivery while staying in a nearby hotel. We got a sausage pizza, cheese garlic bread and boneless wings. Pizza was very good.  Perfect cook and very tasty. Cheese garlic bread was ok, nothing special. Boneless wings were absolutely horrible. By far the worst I've ever had. Pretty sure they were just some kind of frozen kids chicken discs smothered in bbq sauce. Get the pizza. Hard pass on the wings.

Today I enjoyed the portabella mushroom burger and a salad delivered by server Tim, courtesy of the owners, because I am stuck at home in quarantine with a mild case of the Covid-19. Thankfully, it hasn't taken my sense of smell, because the food was delicious! I can't wait to to get well so I can patronize this restaurant in person and try out more of its menu!

Don't do it - don't go here - the food made us sick - really sick - taking covid precautions ?? I think so but someone who is handing the food is not washing their hands after bathroom breaks - gross!!!
One of the better cheese steaks I had on my trip to Philly. It was cooked perfect and it's a great place for a grab and go.

Their wings are amazing! I have yet to try their other dishes since their wings are so good I order them every time. The Mt Helens sauce is delicious and spicy, though if you have a high tolerance for spicy foods you'll need the spiciest sauce they have because the Mt Helens is definitely tolerable. Highly recommend this place for wings.

Mac n Cheese was very dry and mushy! The noodles were over cooked and indistinguishable. There was an INSANE amount of cracked pepper in the Mac n cheese. I'm guessing this was yesterday's Mac n cheese they tried to doctor up. The sauce on the tacos made up for how dry the meat was. Smokey flavor was there but no juices or moisture at all. Everything looks presentable but then you bite into it and realize looks can be deceiving.You guys promised barbecue and I felt I got disappointment instead.
I have been here a handful of times and the pancakes are soooo delicious. The cinnamon toast with their homemade jelly (on the table) is fricken to die for. I miss this place so much.

Food not too bad...but definitely relies on too much salt.  The Rueben poutine seemed like a good idea, but once we tried it we realized what an odd pairing corned beef and kraut was with gravy and fries, and there were almost no curds in it.  Way over salted as well.  My hot chicken sandwich was pretty good, but dry and a little bland.  Brisket sandwich was very good though.  Fries were very oversalted.  Service was pretty disinterested.  Our waiter was attentive at first, but once we got our food, we had to chase him for everything. We had to ask him for refills every time, and then he would move on to something else for five minutes or so, then bring us our refills.  Other stuff, like condiments, napkins, the check, etc., we had to ask the manager.  Also, not sure if its A COVID thing, but very limited menu. Mediocre overall.
Love this place. Everything is soooooo gooood.  Unfortunately I only get to visit once every couple years. Check it out of you are somewhat nearby.

Personally, I had never tried or heard of bingsu before. I'm a big fan of Korean food but this type of dessert has eluded me! VUE Weekly named Snowy Dessert the #1 Best Shaved Ice 2018 and I was more than willing to learn (and taste) more. The only location in Canada, Old Strathcona's (technically it's in CPR Irvine) Snowy Dessert is a part of a famous chain of restaurants from Korea. I visited on a hot and sunny Saturday evening and was determined to make a whole meal out of the experience.

The restaurant is shiny and fresh. They've got a bunch of cute light fixtures in the shape of snow flakes on the ceiling and one that looks like a little alpine town with houses. (Which makes sense because the literal translation of the restaurant's name from Korean is snowy village.) The space is simple and cute with plenty of seating. I found the service to be friendly and cheerful, happy to take our order at the counter.
While bingsu is the main thing at Snowy Dessert, it isn't the only thing. They also offer an array of taiyaki and toasts. I was instantly excited about the taiyaki (something that I have had before). Taiyaki is a classic Japanese street vendor snack. This fish-shaped cake imitates the shape of a Tai fish (or sea bream), which it is named after. Warm and soft, it can contain a variety of fillings. (These get made quite similarly to a waffle.) At this restaurant you can choose from seven different fillings. But they also have a Hot Dog ($3.75) on the menu that seems to

Zaxby's seems pretty average to me. Not bad, but definitely not amazing. I have no big complaints about this specific location-service has been adequate and food has been prepared as ordered. However, the food is just so, so salty! Even the salads! They try to stand apart from their other fried chicken competition by offering things like appetizers and fresh salads made-to-order, but it's not enough to make me prioritize coming here when I have a chicken sandwich craving.

We LOVE El Charro (and this review is for the Sunrise location)!  Apparently they just reopened on Tuesday June 9th Mgr. Dustin shared with me.  IT SHOWED!  I ordered 3 items for curbside pickup.  I arrived curbside and parked in 1 of 4 spots proceeding to call them.  The line was busy for 10-15 minutes as I tried again and again.  Finally, I put my mask on and went in, finding several others waiting for their orders.  I had no idea they had just started curbside pickup 2 days earlier.  The hostess desk was empty...no one there and the phone was on it's cradle!!  Dustin later shared that they had 3 phone lines!!  What?  The young lady heard me out and told me she'd bring the order out to the car apologetically.  10 minutes later she came and brought the order reading it back...3 items including a cheese crisp.  I should have looked myself, but thought maybe it was folded up.  A cheese crisp is the size of a pizza.  I should have looked, but when I got home, no cheese crisp,..called up  sharing my problem with Dustin on the fone.  He was very apologetic but couldn't deliver it as it was too busy and he had no one to drive it over (15 minutes), and offered a complimentary appetizer.  As I drove back wondering why the woman who brought it out didn't realized (based on the size of a cheese crisp-it wasn't included!!!), and picked it up in and out quickly, trying the phone again as I was pulling into their parking lot.  BUSY AGAIN!!  I went in and got the packages.  Like I said, I

Blake's comes in at 3.5.....upgraded to 4
Pros:
Fresh homemade crab cakes with a large proportion of lump crab. 
French fries are homemade fried perfectly and seasoned well.
Sauces are great, I loved the yum sauce with the French fries and crab cake. Yum sauce is mayonnaise with siracha....delicious 
Blake is a great guy, extremely friendly and personable.
Cons:
No crab was available on this morning at 11:05, from what I understand Blake was waiting on his crab delivery. I ended up going back at 230 and I am glad I did.
The roll that came with the crab cake sandwich wasn't good, borderline stale. If fresh bread isn't available, don't offer it or butter and toast it.
I will go back when I am in the area again.

Free parking is available however seating in the restaurant is very limited.
Prices are fair given the portion and quality.

These are very delicious and creative donuts. You will crave them. Just don't expect them to ensure social distancing is being practiced at their facility. They allow the place to be crammed full of people. I can't say for sure if staff wore masks but I don't remember seeing any. So if social distancing and masked food handlers doesn't matter to you, please eat these donuts. They truly are great.

I hate to do this but, this is the second time I order from this place. The first time food was okay. Now, I've ordered a $15 lobster roll with sweet potato fries. Everything was cold & soggy. The sweet potato fries were soggy. The bread on the roll was soggy and broke apart & they put like two strings of lettuce. I was very unhappy with my order. They put no care in the way they prepared my food. There was also very little lobster. Not sure if I'll order from there again honestly.

Polite Society is perfect for a lunch, dinner and brunch, but the latter is my favorite. 

Brunch: Get the southern breakfast and add shrimp (you'll thank me later), avocado toast and add a poached egg or two, chorizo and avocado benedict, or biscuits and gravy. 

Lunch: Try the deviled eggs, the soup of the day - no matter what kind, patty melt, chicken wings, or Croque Madame.

Dinner: Start off with roasted broccoli and cauliflower or sweet potato cornbread; then have with a kale caeser salad; and top it all off with salmon, scallops or the osso bucco. Then go nap.

A delicious little vegan kitchen located inside a health conscious urban grocery store at n downtown Tampa. They serve Impossible Meat in their Philly Cheesesteak and other delectable menu items. Definitely worthy of coming in regularly for a vegan meal. The cooks are very friendly and intelligent behind what makes their food so great. Come and experience this my vegan friends.

Went in after purchasing a Groupon and we were happy with our food.   I had the red neck tacos and they had a little kick but nothing too spicy.  My son had the skillet with Mac and cheese and pulled pork and it was served with a giant piece of cornbread.  He said it was really good.  They weren't very busy and service was quick.   Our server was nice and checked in an appropriate amount of times.  Not the best bbq I've ever had but would go back if I was in the area.

I really was looking forward to having First Watch--it's definitely been a few years--and my first at this particular location. I remember liking them in the past, but after today's experience, I might choose a different breakfast spot. We ordered online for pickup.

There were so many good-sounding items to choose from, I had a hard time deciding. I opted for the chickichanga since it sounded flavorful and something different than you find on other breakfast menus. My husband ordered the pumpkin pancake breakfast. We also got a side of the million dollar bacon.

When it arrived, it looked great...except the fruit "bowl" had two blueberries and three small pieces of pineapple. The potatoes were extremely salty, and that's all you could taste. They were cooked perfectly, crispy on the outside, so it was really disappointing. The main entree was good. Nothing special enough for me to order again.

The bacon was okay. It was spicy and maple syrupy :)

But all in all, it wasn't good enough for me to choose again when we have other breakfast options in the area.

Great for takeout or eat in (the outdoor space has heaters and is Covid friendly). Their gyro meat is hands down the best in the area. The Cheese Saganaki is a great appetizer! I've also had their catering and recommend! The Pastitsio was a crowd pleaser!

I rarely write negative comments but I had to share my disappointment. I decided to try Mexican food, so walked in an looked down. The floor was dirty, sticky, trash on the floor. It was a hangout for the youth. As I approached the order section, instead of "welcome to Chipotle or how may I help you", I was told, "we don't have this & we are out of that too". 1 Star was only selected to attract attention

What an amazing dinner / night. Service and food were on point for my daughter in-laws birthday dinner. The flavors were incredible with each bite i felt that i was being transported to south-east Asia. I can't recommend this place enough they were even accommodating in allowing us to bring in our own birthday cake. Again thank you to the staff and chef.
Great food and great service. This place came highly recommended from our hotel. I can't say enough enough good things about this place. Everything on the menu is worth it to try!

If you want you and your family to get sick and die, order from this unsanitary, irresponsible business. Drivers wear no protective gear, no gloves smoking cigarettes getting saliva on their hands while handling your order. Told my driver NO, to take the food back and to get off of my property! Reporting them to authorities.

This spot had bad reviews so I was Leary about ordering. I ordered Friday night we had steak Stromboli, Buffalo wings, onion rings and fries. Well before we finished I had to order more wings. Well today kids had a cheese pizza and I ordered my wings and fries again. They were great I just asked them to cook chicken crispy

Charming, converted old  house in the heart of Downtown Dunedin that's full of surprises! Met the owner who has been rolling cigars for the last 12 years. Very nice selection, with lots of options for every Cigar smoker. We sat on the front porch so that Hubby could enjoy a "medium" cigar with a nice glass of Malbec. I saw the Cuban coffees and couldn't pass it up, despite it being 4:30 in the afternoon, and it did not disappoint! Only seating at this time is outdoors and there was plenty of room. Great people watching and being right next to the Dog groomer and Barkery, pretty fun dog watching too. We also saw lots of regulars roll up on their golf carts just to come in and get their favorite cigar to go. 
Definitely a repeat!

Absolutely delicious pulled pork sand which. I love places with a good sweet tea! 

It's counter service but they bring the meal to your table. They have a nice outside seating area and a small inside section.

Both the chicken and beef lo mein are amazing. The spicy wontons are delicious. The staff is always so friendly and accommodating. Definitely one of my favorite restaurants. It's quite a drive from where I live, but worth it every single time. Highly recommend!

Very happy to have a nice local place in the Somersett Town Center again!  We enjoyed the food and the setting, and the service was friendly and welcoming.  
The only issues were: 1. The noise level.  It's definitely not a quiet place.  We had two people in our party who have hearing problems, and they had to work at being able to converse.  And this was before the live music started! 
2. We ordered an appetizer to share, salads, and pizzas.  Everything arrived at our table at the same time!  There seemed to be no concept (by the server or kitchen?) that the app should be served first, then the salads, then the pizza. The table was small for our party of four, so all the dishes and the pizzas wouldn't fit. We made the best of it, but next time we'll order each course separately!

So we came here on a whim, having never been before. 
The waiter right away recommended Garlic Crab Fries. If you don't try this then you're missing out on a delicious appetizer. Fries perfectly crisp, lots of crab meat, perfectly seasoned. 

Then I ordered the Lobster Mac. So rich, decadent, cheesy and filled with lobster meat. Honestly, this is one of best places to catch a bite to eat without breaking the bank. 

Worth enjoying a meal or two, then walking down the beach to happily digest.

We've been here more than a handful of times and I've never written a review. I've had to complain to management in the past about service and servers and food, and we always seem to come back every 6 months or so...and I'm certainly glad we did tonite! 
Excellent service!! We had 2 servers, 1 in training, and she was AWESOME! Our appetizer came out fast, followed by salads and then meals. I asked for my (alcoholic) drink to be made without all of the fru-fru stuff and that's exactly how she brought it! Our table was pre-bussed, which I LOVE when the waitstaff does that, and just very attentive to our needs!
Food was delicious and hot!
Thanks y'all for making us love Cheddars 
UPDATE: 3/13/19 So.....they DO NOT HAVE Thousand Island Salad Dressing! Shouldn't a "scratch" kitchen carry Thousand Island? How "Un-American" can you get?!? Also, the honey mustard dressing is more of a honey Dijon dressing, very spicy, also the house salad apparently now comes without eggs, bummer.
Table NOT pre-bussed, service slow. 
What a difference a visit makes.
It'll be awhile before we're back again.
Sorry Cheddar's, taking that 4 star rating down...

Nice lil shack! The prices were inexpensive. Which was shocking considering the area. This area reminded me of Chicago's Bucktown area. They had pizza by the slice & whole by the pie. The family and I had a whole pizza Pie. It was huge. It was delish. The crust was thin, & crispy. NY style cut. The husband would compare it to Sabarros, but I hate Sabarros, & I actually enjoyed this pizza so maybe it looked similar, but tasted differently. Pizza Heads WON hands down! Next time I am in St. Louis I will make a pit stop here for some pizza for sure! 

Psst... while you are there take a sharpie & leave a note on their bath room door/wall or a cool sticker! (It's encouraged). Some neat and funny stuff left behind by other customers.

I like this place and have gone multiple times in a different location at Chattanooga. I was in town and tried the Franklin location. The staff looked like they did not want to be there and was not very friendly. The smoothie was not blended well and it tasted okay but definitely could be better.
Great all American place with one of the best wings I've had. The burgers are enormous.

Rude, cold and unwelcoming is how I would describe the staff.  As a local who enjoys supporting our fine restaurants and bars, my advice would be to spend your money elsewhere!  There are so many lovely, welcoming places that this city has to offer.  The Bouligny is not one of them.  We will never go back and will be sure to let others know about our experience.

Visiting from out of town, found this place on yelp!
It was amazingly stylist, hip, offered great customer service, and the food was delicious! We would come back and recommend this place to our friends n family.
Great attention to Covid protocols and amazing bagels. Worth the drive from Tampa for me for my weekly fix!

When asked for a Center City recommendation for an out of town friend, I spent so much time balancing prices plus options for all types of eaters (picky, adventurous). Coming up with Butcher Bar was my best decision in a while! On a beautiful summer night, the main window is open and there are tables outside, and they have a backyard patio as well. We were seated at a table of 4 on the top floor, which wasn't too cramped and the sound levels/temperature were manageable. 

First off, we were given a wedge salad, compliments of the chef! Not sure how that happened but it was delicious and packed with flavor from the delicious blue cheese to the bacon and onions. The duck confit wings were pretty amazing, with tons of flavor and a good amount of meat on each one. The boar ribs came in a huge portion, with honey cornbread (extremely sweet, I loved it) and that allowed us some big leftovers. The gnocci was so fresh and obviously made with love and attention. I've never had gnocci so light and buttery before. The veggies (tomatoes, asparagus) in the bowl made the entire experience really pleasant, and everything went well together. I got to try a bit of the garlic bread, which was buttery and had a good crisp to it. From the other two guests, I was told the cheesy grits were extremely cheesy, and the meatballs were very good as well! The pasta came with so much sauce, so if you're a sauce lover, this might be the dish for you. Along with an attentive waiter, quick service on a busy
The outdoor dining area is fabulous. The server was attentive without being smothering and the vegetarian sandwich and chili were very good.

This is a hidden morning gem in Clearwater. Sylvia, originally from Belgium, brings Belgian and Leige (made with sugar pearls) waffles to life. We were warmly greeted by Sam and he explained the concept of Sylvia's waffles concisely and with consideration. $41 got us breakfast for 4. Sylvia was even able to accommodate bacon made: soft, crispy, and extra crispy. We will definitely be back!

We have lived in New Orleans 3 years and tried just about every donut shop (believe me, I work at a hospital, someone brings donuts every day) and city donuts is pound for pound the best donut shop in town. It is reliable, cheap, and open 24/7; all the qualities of the quintessential donut shop. On top of that the donuts are delicious. The cake donuts have an initial almost crunch on the outside and then a soft, perfectly textured interior. The glazed donuts are also awesome, but could use a bit more puff. Overall awesome donut shop and great service as well!

Must be a poke love explosion. We have seen so many lately. This one will be the first few at Wesley Chapel. Island Fin has found love by the local community. I would said they are just a bit above the  average poke restaurant for the reason they are generous on the topping.

I choose the protein as tuna and octopus. They mixed the mixed in and the protein with the sauce. Which is good and make it flavorful. If they have sesame oil will be better. Not all the mixed in are included. Some has up charge. The time we have visited, the people who have the mixer is a bit heavy on sauce. 

The other thing like it here is their dole whip with mango and pineapple soft serve. It is delicious. I thing this will bring them to the top. This unique soft serve is the first in Bay Area.

I called to place a to-go order and the time it took for her to explain to me where to look it up she could have taken our order! What do you do if you don't have access to look up the website or you have food allergies? Pure laziness on your take out team!! We ordered elsewhere! 
PS: When we ordered last week our entrees were completely wrong but we wanted to give you a break with everything going on with Covid right now. And they did take our order over the phone that time.

I have visited Wilmington four times this year and always make it to Bardea and their pizza/salad spot in DECO.  I happened to be in DE on my birthday this year and Bardea was where I chose to have dinner.  Food is wonderful.  Can't wait until January when I will be back.

This spot has the best sandwiches in Santa Barbara. I've tried just about every shop in town! But that's not all, it also has a great selection of gourmet goodies. Truffle potato chips, anyone? The prices are totally doable! Especially the sandwiches! The staff is so friendly and sweet.

So many great reviews on here.  I must have caught them on an off night.  I had the worst meal I've ever had.  The Nashville Hot Chicken was overcooked, dry as dirt and so hard I couldnt bite into it. Had lots of heat, but no flavor. Served on soft Taco shells which were soggy from the slaw, sauce, etc.  Should have been served on crunchy tortillas. The mozzerella sticks are HUGE, but not very good.  The mozzerella was poor quality, as was the Parmesan (store brand out of a Shaker can). Quality Mozzerella would be such an improvement.  However, the Mexican Street Corn is WONDERFUL!! Perfect flavor. 

Cocktails were ok.  Not great. 

No kitchen is perfect every time.  I will return in hope of a better experience.

The wife and I went here for a day time date on 19 February 2021. The server didn't really seem to show an interest in her job.  The French dipped sandwich was soggy on arrival. My wife said it was essentially just pre cut sandwich meat.The grilled salmon BLT was decent (I had that) , just lacked ANY type of seasoning. The best thing food wise were the duck fat tater tots and I'm assuming that's because they were pre made out the box. The drinks we had were all a huge waste of time and money. I had the "sixty-fifteen" and it was a disappointment.  My wife had the "Moscow mule" and after two sips she sent it back for a different drink. The next drink brought out was unnamed and tasted the exact same as the "Moscow mule". Our total was 73$ and of course we tipped anyway, but if you value your taste buds and money... this is not the place to get the best bang for your buck. We felt like we were complaining too much about the food and drinks (even though we paid for quality) so we somewhat felt like we just had to deal with what we were given. Unfortunate experience for our date, would give 0 stars if possible. These ratings are solely on the food and drinks, we do not know why the server was so crabby.
So yummy and fresh! Love the vegetarian fajitas (minus the onions). Staff are super nice and very attentive!

Locos is starting to become my favorite Mexican restaurant in Indianapolis. The pastor tacos, although heavy on the onions, are very tasteful and filling (if you don't fill up on the chips and queso ). The service was well worth a 20% tip, which is a refreshing change up from most Mexican restaurants I'm accustomed to. My only compliant was that our server forgot to bring straws but other than that it was a great Sunday night dining experience with my beautiful girlfriend.
The food is so tiny on your plate! And everything is so spicy! Will not be back. Who wants a tiny steak and couple pieces of broccoli? That wouldn't even fill my dog up.

Called ahead to ask about wait times and ADA accessibility I was told they were accessible and would be able to seat us immediately. They had a ramp for entry, but the parking spaces were limited and difficult to exit with a wheelchair. When we entered the restaurant, we were asked if we had a reservation and the staff seemed bewildered about how to accommodate us and aggravated that they had to move the seating around. The place had plenty of seating and there was no need to make the party with eleven move tables for our party of five. We were unable to eat there as they only have brunch on Sundays and the limited menu did not meet my grandparents dietary requirements. The lunch/breakfast menu did and there was no mention that only brunch was served on Sundays on the website.

I was craving Thai food, so my family and I decided to check out Zen Yai after reading reviews on Yelp. We visited the restaurant on a Friday night, around 7, and it was completely empty (in fact, we even thought it was closed!) The service was great, though and we were promptly seated. We tried the chicken saté, the fried tofu, yellow curry, and pineapple fried rice. The food was fresh and loaded with veggies, but it was nothing special. It might be the best Thai food in Santa Barbara, but that's not saying a lot. Maybe we should've taken the emptiness as a hint and tried another place.

I finally decided to try Luke's Italian Beef. I was totally disappointed.  I order the Luke's Italian beef sandwich, supposedly their best sandwich.  I hadn't even paid the cashier and less than 2 minutes the sandwich was ready.  Ok, wow they fast, or everything was ready from the previous night.  We were the first customers for that day 10AM sharp.  The sandwich was awful, I understand that they are supposed to be greasy, but this thing was flat nasty. It was cold and it tasted like a wet mop.  So, yea not good.

Went in on Sunday 10/04/2020 and the place was hopping. Great atmosphere and really friendly wait staff. Took a little longer than usual to get initially asked for our drink order but that is fairly common when seated in the "bar area." Got the bottomless brunch drink special which includes Bloody Mary, Mamosa's, White Sangria, and Red Sangria. I love that you can interchange the drinks and still get charged the same. I listed the drinks in order of how much I enjoyed them (the Bloody Mary was soooo good and had just the right spice).

We ordered the beef on weck and hot honey chicken sandwich. We opted for the upgraded Mac-n-cheese as one of our sides and the french fries for the other side. Both sandwiches were really good, but the chicken sandwich won between the two. Both sides were also very well done and the overall experience was great! I will definitely be back!

Now that restaurants are slowly opening up we were so excited to go on a date night at Pier 48! The patio is large which was great for social distancing and there were barely an pedestrians walking about which was also a plus since we sat outside. Unfortunately the menu is very limited right now (we really wanted to seafood tower, but I guess we will just have to go back another time). I ordered the lobster Mac n cheese and my date ordered the lobster roll. We both were very happy! Also they had $6 margs and $3 drafts. In the picture the blue drink is coconut rum cocktail called Dock of the Bay. It was delicious. Moreover, I have two notes for management-- the menus didn't have descriptions of the food or drinks. With vague drink names like "Hoosier Shake Up" "French 48" and "Sitting on the dock of the bay" it would be nice to have descriptions! Our waitress didn't even have a clue what the drinks were so she had to go back to the kitchen to ask. Additionally, while our waitress was very nice, her mask was not sitting over her nose and exposing all customers! There's no point in wearing it if both the nose and mouth are not covered.

This place has gone downhill for the last several months. It's very conveniently located for me so begrudgingly, I have continued to go 
now and then. Tonight though is my last time. Not only has the fish become questionable but tonight the service was nonexistent. I sat at the sushi bar for 10 minutes all the while watching servers walk back-and-forth past me. After never being so much as  looked at, let alone asking if I would like a drink or maybe to order some food, I left.  It's very sad but I highly recommend avoiding this restaurant. It's not what it used to be. It's terrible in all aspects.

Very impressed by this restaurant. I just went there this morning. Everything about the restaurant is positive. Food came out fast coffee was incredible service was delightful. I love hole in the wall places like this. You will not be disappointed!

Late on a Tuesday and I almost walked to 2nd and Market with nothing being opened! Super happy to have stumbled upon this place, which I've seen online recently. The prices are all pretty average for the neighborhood, and the cheesesteak fries, while small, were so cheesy, juicy and delicious! The steak on top was perfectly cooked, and the mac and cheese burger was cooked nicely as well. It was weird that everything closed so early, but being able to eat here was the highlight of my evening. Food came out quickly, they have a patio and indoor space, and I feel like I'll be back next time I'm around that area and need a cheesesteak.

I'm honestly quite sad to see that this place has such divided reviews! My review is limited to one experience but boy did I LOVE IT! My best friends from college and I had met in Carmel for a weekend together. We had planned to eat elsewhere but when our reservations fell through, we could see a deli spot oddly attached to a gas station in the distance. It wasn't ideal but we were far too hungry to try to find somewhere else to eat at 8 o'clock on a Saturday. 
This place did not disappoint! We were able to seat 8 individuals and get great service rather quickly. There was only one bartender doubling as a server and he kicked ass at his job! He was so incredibly kind and stayed on top everything! I was very impressed. 
I was also very impressed with the food! I mean SMOKED WINGS... GAME CHANGER!!! Never again will I ever make wings any other way. So incredible! We had planned on getting the wings as as appetizer but ended up ordering more as our meal. YES. They were that good! 
My only reason for not giving a full 5 stars is because service did pick up and that poor bar tender was having to work his tail end off for everyone. Hopefully management doesn't always poorly staff the place like this and it was just an odd night. Got to take care of your staff too.

Sometimes you just need a Chorizo and Eggs sub when you are Vegetarian. Cajun is my go to when I need a fix. 
Great service. Food was excellent. Coffee was HOT. 

Social Distancing throughout the restaurant. Staff was very polite when people came without masks. 

Will be back again. Soyrizo and Eggs were Great as always.
A delightful place for dinner, especially before an SB Bowl event.  Pleasant people, nice setting, and really good and occasionally different food.

This was my first time trying out this Thai restaurant. My brother in-law recommended this place to me. It has an ethnic ambiance and the food is good and much more affordable compared to our go to Thai restaurant. I ordered the Panang curry with white rice.

The food needs a little kick in the butt and the staff could communicate better as well. I enjoyed the view and the drinks were strong. The conch fritters were good as well but a little dark for my liking which means the oil was dirty. The flounder needs a little bit more flavor so I had to use my salt and pepper generously! Other than that it was descent.
Very nice meal. Portions are very generous. Chicken was excellent and so was the Greek salad.
Always uses the freshest products! Staff are incredible and personable. Best chicken in town by far! Drive thru also the fastest

What can I say, this place is sheer heaven. We must have tried everything....the pimento cheese, divine. The Cesar salad...no words. The garlic bread with burrata...holy cow. Fried chicken with the honey sauce is the best I've ever had IN MY LIFE. And then the pizza....avocado pizza, I want it always, and then the pear pizza, so fresh and refined. Then let's talk about the mussels and divine coconut curry. And THE BREAD...literally nothing like it outside of France. RUN don't walk to this divine, family owned restaurant for the best meal in Santa Barbara and I promise you will be a member of the clean plate club!!

I was planning a Friendsgiving and expecting over 20 people so i thought what better way to cater, then ordering from my neighborhood Publix! I placed an online order 2 days before my event for 50 naked wings, 2 lbs of pulled pork, 2 lbs of potato wedges, and a lb of fried okra and scheduled a pickup time for Saturday at 7:30 (pm). At 7:05 i get a call from Publix confirming my order for 7:30 am the following day... (is Publix even open at 7:30 am??) After explaining to the worker that my party was that night she promised that the food would be ready in time. I wait until 8:30 to pick up the food to give them plenty of time to get it ready and when I got to the deli I had to wait 15 minutes for one of the five employees standing around doing nothing to actually speak to me. After giving my name they seemed confused and could only locate my wings and potato wedges. Then I was advised that they had been out of okra and it would take 10 minutes for the pork to be ready. What is the point of putting in an online order 2 days beforehand if they aren't going to reserve the materials needed or even have it ready at the right time?! At this point I'm stressed and irritated so Brenda (the worker that called me earlier) gave me a pan of stale old macaroni and said she "hooked me up" with pulled pork. I get home and unveil all of the food to my guests and low and behold, Brenda "hooked me up" with whole unpulled chunks of pork that was greasy and fatty. Someone had to devote 20 minutes
Wonderful coffee house. Great coffee environment, great location and great coffee. The Van Gogh Milky Way is delicious and everyone is very kind that works there. Truly a treat :)

I ordered takeout from DEGTHAI on Thursday, February 25, 2021 around 6 pm. Despite the short amount of time I spent inside this fast-casual establishment, I can confidently say that I was impressed by the interior design and how seriously they take their COVID precautions. The dining area had spaced out tables and looked like they were regularly maintained. Considering many food trucks aren't able to serve high quality food due to sacrificing presentation and quality for production volume, I was also impressed that DEGTHAI was still able to exceptionally deliver in both facets, even for takeout.

The street dumplings were great. The chicken and shrimp filling was seasoned well and had a nice consistency. The dumplings were wrapped very well and were able to hold their shape after steaming to perfection. The OG shrimp pad thai had good flavors and I appreciated that it was DRY and not too saucy, which is how traditional pad thai should be cooked (it's called OG for a reason!). The tiew tom yum goong was aromatic and had the perfect balance of Thai spices. Both noodles in the noodle dishes were cooked properly and weren't mushy. 

Based on the overall quality and their food-truck portion sizes, I thought the price value is average. It is a little expensive for the portion size, but I think the flavors definitely make up for the slight additional cost. I didn't mind that they kept the same limited food truck menu for this establishment as long as the kitchen can consistently del

Today was our first time at Joes. I had the Joes special pizza which was scrumptious! We also had the fried portabellos which are to die for!! The staff was super friendly and went above and beyond. Couldn't have been happier. Highly recommend!

My favorite Korean restaurant in U.S. My favorite dish is tofu soup with seafood.  I love this! It tastes exactly the same as what I had in Seoul. The appetizers are good and can be refilled. Service is good and the price is fair. Highly recommend!

If you think you might enjoy a variation of American brunch with a Mediterranean flair, try Spice Finch, Top Chef Jen Carroll's newest restaurant experience in Rittenhouse Square. The Berbere Crisps have a nice spicy kick to them and will leave a dusting of heat on your lips as you try to temper them with any of six different spreads. My friend Ken and I tried the Tahina (with sesame, lemon, and olive oil) and Beet Borani (with feta cheese and za'atar), a nice pairing of salty and sweet with the spiciness. For my entrée, I ordered the Shakshuka, a skillet dish with spiced tomato, peppers, nigella seeds, and an egg cooking from the heat still in the skillet. My dish was accompanied by a thick, warm, pillowy soft sourdough pita. Sooooo delicious was my dish, I could not help but gobble it up spoonful after glorious spoonful. It reminded me of an exotic ratatouille! For dessert, I ordered the Burnt Cream, a large disk of toasted cream that sat in a pool of heavenly sweet rose syrup and topped with fresh berries. Basically a Turkish-style variation of créme brulée, this was a marvelous sweet treat to end a gloriously spiced meal.

Bryn & Danes has amazing food.  I asked my daughter where she wanted to have lunch...expecting her to suggest greasy fast food. I was pleasantly surprised when she chose Bryn & Danes. We love it there!

Love this spot. The train is cool and has a lot of choices. The inside has cool art, but you can tell they don't have enough storage space. Looks a little meh, but the sushi is amazing and super fresh. I'd typically say a little pricy,  but for all you can eat it's worth it by far.  Plus the chef will just make you special rolls. It's my go to for sure when I wanna throw down.

First Panera I've ever been to that insisted the kids meals were only half a sandwich. We talked to two different staff members about it, even so far as showing them the picture that illustrates a full sandwich with the meal on their very own ordering kiosks, and neither cared. Had to hover people to get tables and left with kids that were still hungry. Ridiculous.

The food here was so good. I mean talk about a hidden gem in the middle of a more residential area. You wouldn't really expect this cafe there. But it works. Parking was a little bit of a pain, but manageable. During our short trip to Philly we managed to come here twice, yes it was that good and worth it. If we would have stayed longer I'm sure we would have come back at least one more time, maybe twice lol. The brisket was so good, very flavorful and just overall satisfying. The pineapple mango juice was really good too. Iced lattes and cappuccinos were also tasty. Cappuccino had a little more punch to it, but very good. Glad to have a new philly spot to eat.

We came to Fleming's for my aunts 90th birthday celebration. We were greeted by a beautifully wrapped Birthday card and a large colorful printed sheet saying happy 90th birthday Sally.  We then received three complementary glasses of celebratory champagne. Our dinner was wonderful. I ordered the 11 ounce filet mignon rare plus and it was the first time in any restaurant that it actually came out exactly as ordered. The fillet was so flavorful and so tender you could have cut it with a fork. Our other two entrées were wonderful as well. They allowed us to bring in a birthday cake which they served us with coffee. When we were ready to leave , they presented her with a beautifully boxed and ribbon tied quartet of truffles. All in all the best birthday service we have ever received. Highly recommend this location for your celebration!

I don't know why there are so many negative reviews on here. Place was nice. Food was cooked, and hot. My server, I believe her name is Stevie,  was attentive and thoughtful, despite a pretty decent amount of people in the diner, and just her and one other person serving. 
Prices were good, about $15 for one person (plus a dessert), as was the food itself good. Fries reminded me a bit of Curly's in Wildwood for some odd reason. I also got a little bit of cake as a little treat for myself. It was so yummy! Atmosphere reminded me of that genuine 50's type diner. As for dessert, cake was nice and fluffy and icing wonderfully decadent. Ice cream was thick and creamy. 
Additionally, I love how it's all day breakfast. Will definitely keep that in mind for next time I find myself here. I see myself hankering for some pancakes.

Disgusting. My party and I waited 50 minutes on the street with sewage gas being blown in our faces and puddles of dirty water. A colleague told me it was worth the wait, but it was not. When we got inside, the smell of fish and raw seafood hits your nostrils. I ordered red beans and rice and my husband ordered oysters on the half shell and jambalaya. The portions were small, the dishes were expensive, and the taste was subpar. The beans and rice lacked smoke and the jambalaya and oysters lacked flavor. Go elsewhere.

This place is open during the pandemic and offering take out and outside seating. So if your looking for a seafood spot near by to enjoy the summers weather and good food this is the place.

I stopped here my first time on Father's Day for take out. Ordered the crab cakes garlic mashed potatoes and broccoli. The crab cakes had been done just right and the garlic mashed was amazing. Can never have to much garlic and this mashed was done perfectly. If I could change anything to this meal would have been lovely if they cooked the broccoli in butter and garlic. 

I came here for a second spin this time ordering two meals. The meal I choose for myself was the honey jalapeño sea scallops and for my lady the broiled seafood platter.

The honey jalapeño sea scallops topped with crab meat cooked golden brown. Came with two side one being the sautéed French beans and the other sweet mashed potatoes. The scallops was great I wish I had picked the food up sooner. The topped crab meat was amazing and the cocktail sauce they packaged with the meal must have been homemade. To be honest the cocktail sauce was one of my favorite parts to this dish. 

The broiled seafood platter was pretty great as well. The garlic mashed potatoes are amazing here so flavorful. The shrimp came out great and my lady would agree. And to top it off the cocktail sauce again lol was perfect. This dish came with so much even salmon which was a hearty piece. We managed to turn that dish into enough for two.

So... If you're a foodie, that's into hidden gems of flavor, where the food is the focus... This place is for you!  Besides the fact, you won't find a better cup of true Cuban Cafe con leche... Their Madame Theresa dessert will make you a true believer, and have you waking up in the middle of the night with a smile on your face from dreaming about it.  Great food, prepared with love, attentive service, and did I mention the Cafe con leche???  Why aren't you here already???

*I'm a Foodie, and only post on the places that make my Best of list
I always hear about this place, but yesterday my husband and I we decided go and give a try, was awesome, it is a different pizza taste but if you now about good food you will love it

This was suggested to us.  It is great, I really like the picnic style tables. We got here and we're sure what to expect as it is a seat yourself and only one person at the counter, with customers.  She came over apologized and got us served very promptly. We got the meat sampler, brisket was my favorite. It had a nice smoky flavor, very tender.  Ribs were my husband's preference, they were served dry and had a nice sweet bbq flavor.  He does like a little kick so he opted for the spicy bbq sauce.  We got house salads that were a lettuce blend, tomatoes, green onions, and shredded cheddar, perfectly per-portioned so you don't feel like your just eating lettuce. Busy, but service keeps up.
Causal fun place.  Most excellent Grouper sandwich. Not somewhere thAt you want to sit all night, but grab a meal and beverage then head down the beach.

While the staff was friendly and helpful, our experience wasn't great due to two major points. 

1. BUGS! We found these little black bugs on our bed and on the floor. We looked it up and they were not bed bugs but looked more like baby beetles.

2. COVID protocols! We just got back from a weekend trip and were expecting the hotel to be following the safety measures listed on their website. We rarely saw team members wiping down slot machines or high touch areas. There were hand sanitizer stations available through out the casino/hotel but we were expecting to see them wipe down much more often. It was so crowded that they opened up all seats at their tables when they were supposed to keep some seats closed for social distancing. They even turned on some slot machines which were supposed to be off for social distancing as well. We expected them to limit capacity and have more strict measures in place such as limiting the number of guests in elevators, etc.

Overall, after taking the chance of visiting so soon after opening, we were really disappointed with this experience.

Cannot say enough good things about SushiLin. 
Since Covid I've been relying on take out. I keep coming back to SushiLin. They're open late and their place is clean, and their food is great. And, in my opinion, they could easily raise their prices and I would still go there. 
My current favorites are "Singapore Maifun" and "Lemon Honey Walnut Shrimp". Mouthwatering.

If you want a restaurant with a nice environment, good service and friendly prices.  Chili's is for you.  I got a $10 meal deal and what a treat. The food is not great, but for that price, you can't complaint much.  The staff is so friendly.
One of my favorite ramen spots in the city. I usually get their matzo-ball ramen and get it spicy!

Go every week for free trivia night, so much fun! The food is always so good, I get something new every time I go and it's always delicious! Chicken wraps are delish! Homemade chips are so awesome, my favorite thing! The tacos are awesome, everything on the menu is great. Service is great, lots of really nice staff. Even when they're busy they keep up with every table

My friends and I came down to Boise last night and we wanted to try something new! The food was absolutely delicious! The customer service was amazing, and the owner even stopped by are table to check in and see how we were doing! The restaurant just had a great atmosphere overall! Will be back for sure!

Since I've been staying at USF, Babushka's has become my go-to for Uber Eats. My favorite dish is the sweet cheese-filled pancakes for dessert. It's a generous portion of 3 large pancakes, and they taste terrific the next day for breakfast. The stuffed cabbage was more flavorful than the stroganoff, which I found a little chewy. The borscht, served hot, is meaty and hearty with big chunks of tender beef and potatoes in a rich beet broth. For fans of Russian food, or somebody looking for something different than the usual take-out or delivery, this restaurant is highly recommended.

I really enjoyed this food. The signage gives the impression that it's some kind of Thai fast food. It is not. Food was great! Looks like a family owned place. When I came to pic my food up, the owner was cooking and these two precious little girls were playing in the front area. He is a really nice guy and on top of that, he can cook. Please give them a try. This is a restaurant you won't mind spending your money at.
